Тропатепина Гидрохлорид C22H23NS,HCl = 370.0. CAS — 27574-24-9 (tropatepine); 27574-25-0 (tropatepine hydrochloride). ATC — N04AA12. ATC Vet — QN04AA12. (tropatepine) Profile Tropatepine hydrochloride is an antimuscarinic with actions and uses similar to those of trihexyphenidyl (p.820). It is used in the management of parkinsonism (p.791), including the alleviation of the extrapyramidal syndrome induced by drugs such as phe- nothiazines, but, like other antimuscarinics, is of no value in tar- dive dyskinesias. Tropatepine hydrochloride is given orally in usual doses of 10 to 30 mg daily; it is also given intramuscularly or by slow intravenous injection in doses of 10 to 20 mg daily.
